title: A sparse array under the array-cell budget is untouched
rationale: A sparse array well under the cell budget. The bound is a ceiling on (union of distinct keys) x (element count), and this document is 3 x 3 = 9 cells against a budget of 16, so nothing about it changes.
catchesBugClass: A budget that is enforced too eagerly - an off-by-one on the wrong side of the comparison, or a counter that charges cells it does not allocate, would refuse this row.
cannotCatch: It cannot show what the bound is FOR; array-cells-one-over-max carries that. It also cannot distinguish 'the budget was not reached' from 'the budget is not enforced at all', which is why the three rows are recorded together.

predicted.detail: Nine cells against a budget of sixteen. The cell bound never fires and the output is byte-identical to the default configuration.
